content.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Users say updates have made the app harder to use, especially by limiting control over songs and personal playlists or removing familiar features.","issue_id":"ISSUE-USABILITY","name":"App usability and feature changes"},{"description":"Users report songs playing unexpectedly or not playing at all, and playback stopping when they switch to other apps.","issue_id":"ISSUE-PLAYBACK","name":"Unreliable music playback"},{"description":"Users object to unexpected charges and to core features becoming unavailable after a premium subscription ends or without paying.","issue_id":"ISSUE-BILLING","name":"Charges and premium restrictions"},{"description":"General dissatisfaction with the app or its updates without a specific problem identified.","issue_id":"ISSUE-OTHER","name":"General dissatisfaction"},{"description":"Users have difficulty searching for music, browsing genres, and discovering or revisiting content through the interface.","issue_id":"ISSUE-CATALOG","name":"Finding and discovering music"},{"description":"Users cannot log in or access their accounts, sometimes after an error or app loading failure.","issue_id":"ISSUE-ACCESS","name":"Account access and login problems"},{"description":"Users report lost downloads and playlists, problems playing music offline, and downloaded or local files disappearing or becoming inaccessible.","issue_id":"ISSUE-DOWNLOADS","name":"Downloads and offline listening problems"},{"description":"Users are disappointed with customer service responses and the handling of questions or eligibility concerns.","issue_id":"ISSUE-SUPPORT","name":"Customer support concerns"}]}
